Run Claude Code on a dedicated Mac mini in California

Reviewed: 2026-11-08 · wodeMac

wodeMac rents physical Mac minis hosted in California, each to one customer only. Claude Code and OpenAI Codex come preinstalled and you get admin rights. You sign in to Claude Code with your own Anthropic account; wodeMac charges only for the machine and does not resell or share AI accounts.

Why run Claude Code on a remote Mac?

Long agent runs stop when your laptop sleeps, loses Wi-Fi or is busy with other work. A Mac that stays online 24/7 keeps the repository, dependencies and running tasks in one place, so Claude Code can keep working after you close your own computer. It also gives Windows and Linux developers a real macOS machine for Xcode builds and tests.

What you get

  • A physical M6 Mac mini (16GB memory, 256GB storage), not a shared VM.
  • Claude Code and Codex preinstalled, with admin rights.
  • Remote desktop through the preinstalled wodeMac Remote Screen app.
  • Delivery usually within 24 hours and no later than 3 business days.

Accounts and limits

The price covers the machine only. Claude Code runs on your own Claude subscription or API key, under Anthropic's usage policies and supported regions. Hosting the Mac in California does not change those rules. For maintenance, wodeMac and its hosting provider keep administrative access.

FAQ

Is Claude Code preinstalled?

Yes. Claude Code and Codex are installed when the Mac is delivered. You sign in with your own account.

How much does it cost?

$169 monthly, $481.65 quarterly, $912.60 half-yearly or $1,723.80 yearly (about $143.65 a month), paid upfront for the machine only.

Is the Mac shared with other customers?

No. Each physical Mac mini is rented to one customer. wodeMac and the hosting provider keep admin access for maintenance.
